fieldValues.title: Close seam 3: srs-core struct vs mirrored JSON Schema property parity
fieldValues.summary: Implemented srs_schema::conformance::assert_property_parity, an exhaustive-destructure-paired checker that diffs a struct's schema-facing required/optional property names against the mirrored docs/schema/2.0/*.json at build time. Wired into Field (+AiGuidance/Lineage/Provenance) and RecordType (+FieldAssignment). Reproduces srs-rust#769 as a permanent regression test.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from #580 pool top-up (2026-09-08). Ground: read #777 body plus its two prior comments (epic-256 narrowing: this issue is a named follow-on, not an epic-closure blocker) and the dispatch comment naming mode/cell/door. Classify: mode complicated, cell Conformance, door 1/non-normative (CI gate, tooling only) - matches the coordinator dispatch, no reason to override. Charter: no existing mechanism does struct-vs-schema property-set comparison; the RFC-031 MAPPING table precedent is retired/empty because its entities are now generated from the same source as the schema, which is NOT true of srs-core's hand-authored structs, so this is a genuine permanent gap, not a tautological duplicate. Route: proceeds (clear/complicated + door 1). Work: implemented in crates/srs-schema/src/conformance.rs, wired into srs-core field.rs and record_type.rs tests; both gates green (cargo build --workspace, cargo test --workspace with SRS_SPEC_DIR pointed at a fresh origin/master worktree, cargo clippy -D warnings). Prove: deliberately dropped fieldType from Field's required list, confirmed the test failed with a property-parity mismatch, reverted, confirmed green. Land: PR the-greenman/srs-rust#996, gate:auto-merge armed.
